payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Revisit existing monitor-capacity flake sase-12f — check ToolRun 804cd408b2b32ed47b9f88e827134e2f exited 1/no_new_failures with the renamed delayed-child-bootstrap node triaged FLAKY; sase-12f already tracks repeated loaded-lane evidence.

Fixed Files spread Ctrl-J by scheduling the page jump after reserve-backed layout, requiring the live anchor to be within max_scroll_y, and retrying until the refreshed view confirms the landing; transition generations discard stale callbacks. Earlier 1c1.7 only invalidated the old transition restore, while 1i5.7 made the test follow a moving target; neither reapplied a scroll clamped against the old extent. Verified 20 focused spread/block pilot tests under six workers and six spread-pilot-file copies under six workers (78 passed, including repeated Files jumps). sase tool run check exited 1/no_new_failures: formatting, lint, SASE validation, and committed-plan checks passed; the sole FLAKY delayed-child-bootstrap failure is tracked by sase-12f and noted as follow-up. epic-symbols was empty.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: tests/tool/test_observe.py::test_executor_records_samples_and_show_lists_them still flakes under xdist load — saw 2 samples where >=3 were asserted in 1 of ~10 -n 8 runs on a tree whose changes do not touch it; already tracked by sase-19u, which is not in the v0.18.0 phase plan, so it is a candidate to fold into a later phase or the land agent triage.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: tests/fakey/test_monitor_capacity_e2e.py::test_weight_two_land_agent_session_retains_one_claim_through_real_dispatch_and_delayed_child_bootstrap failed once in the escalated full just check ("agent land--1 did not finish", 92s, thread_alive=True) and passes solo in 67s; triaged FLAKY with no owning bead (ToolRun 140f8d705d35e76dfe342005729ca1a3). It is a load-sensitive 60-90s e2e, not a Full CI failure seen so far.

Root-caused and fixed sase-1k9, sase-1j4 and sase-1ht in tests only; no production change. 1k9: probe test now runs in-process with a 1.0s mint wait and 60s deadline, so worker/fake-CLI start-up cannot consume the budget (reproduced by delaying worker start 1.4s; passes with a 1.4s fake-CLI start delay). 1j4: git commit forks 'git maintenance run --auto --detach' (verified via GIT_TRACE2_EVENT); tests/conftest.py session gitconfig now sets maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0, with a trace-based regression test in tests/sdd/test_git_identity_fixture.py that fails without the fix; observe has no copy path of its own. 1ht: the old test let the reader race the child's two writes (reproduced as 'assert 1200 < 1200' with a 0.3s gap); the test now starts the reader after the child confirms both pipes are written and asserts stderr is read within _JSONL_RECORD_BUDGET records, passing with the same 0.3s gap. Verification: sase tool run check escalated to the full suite (root conftest changed): 56425 passed, 1 failed (tests/fakey/test_monitor_capacity_e2e.py delayed_child_bootstrap, triaged FLAKY, passes solo in 67s, unrelated); touched files stable over 9 runs at -n 8. Two PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs recorded (sase-19u sample-count flake; monitor capacity e2e). epic-symbols: none.
